text:
laura_sales: Ok team — ACME POC kickoff. Need a quick baseline for prompts + a short note on cost tradeoffs. Can we align on scope and deliverables?

michael_se: On it. What's the exact scope? Summarization + extraction?

laura_sales: Yes. Two flows: (A) support-thread summarization (short threads, 1-3 messages), (B) catalog entity extraction for tagging/search. Want baseline prompts, 1st-pass evals, and a simple cost model to show the customer.

tess_eng: Latency SLO? token budget per request? Any infra constraints?

laura_sales: Target p95 latency <= 300ms. Cost goal ~ $0.005 per request (ballpark). Also customer requires no data egress from their VPC — legal flagged it.

omar_ml: For baseline I propose: use a smaller open model (7B quant) for dev baseline, produce prompt templates + 50 eval pairs per flow. We should collect ~200 real samples if possible for final eval.

sarah_success: Customer can provide anonymized threads. I'll upload a sample pack. Also FYI security questionnaire called out: data retention of model artifacts + export controls.

laura_sales: @omar_ml can you draft the baseline prompts? Example summarization prompt below — feel free to iterate:

```
Summarize the customer support thread in 1-2 sentences.
Keep tone neutral. List any action items as bullets if present.
Input: <<THREAD>>
Output:
```

omar_ml: Good start. For extraction use few-shot examples (5 shots) with explicit labels. Suggested eval metrics: F1 for entities, Rouge-L for summary, plus a small human preference A/B for final quality checks.

michael_se: Pricing question from sales: how to present token cost simply? Need a one-liner formula for customer decks.

tess_eng: Formula: cost_per_request = (avg_input_tokens + avg_output_tokens) * price_per_token + infra_buffer. I'll run perf numbers on a dev GPU and post estimated tokens/sec and latencies today.

laura_sales: Timeline: need baseline prompts + 50 eval pairs per flow by EOD Friday (5 days). Can everyone confirm?

omar_ml: I can deliver baseline prompts and ~50 eval samples per flow using the sample pack. Full 200 samples requires more customer uploads.

sarah_success: Uploading now: https://drive.redwood/acme/poc-sample (shared with team). I'll also start answers for the security questionnaire fields about retention and access controls.

michael_se: Blocker: Legal asked for a short model provenance README for any open model we propose. @tess_eng can you assemble a one-pager with model name, license, and known limitations?

tess_eng: Yep — will put together model README + perf table. Also flag: hosted fallback to public API would violate the customer's VPC requirement; need dedicated/private deployment note in the runbook.

laura_sales: Action items recap: Omar -> draft prompts + initial evals; Tess -> perf numbers + model README; Sarah -> upload dataset + SQA answers; Michael -> simple pricing writeup for deck. Thanks all :thumbsup:
